SMTO-EXE-0267 — A workflow step finished without the result it was supposed to produce

GUID: 548d773f-7cb3-56f2-be82-0b24b0db7425
Slug: recipe-postcondition-failed
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: recipes

What happened

  • SMTO tried to finish this workflow, but a required step hadn't completed, or a step succeeded without returning the result later steps need. SMTO didn't mark the workflow as done.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the run's conversation and find the step that is incomplete or marked as failed. That step is what keeps the workflow from finishing.
  2. Check whether that step's change actually happened, for example open the file or item it should have created. The step may have done its work even though SMTO didn't get the result it expected.
  3. If it didn't happen, ask SMTO in the conversation to complete only that step. Doing just the missing step avoids repeating the steps that already finished.
  4. If the workflow keeps stopping at the same step, save your request again with Save to workflow and use the new workflow. A fresh save runs your request as a normal task instead of following the old recorded steps.

What success looks like

  • All required steps show as finished, and the run is marked complete in the workflow's History.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the workflow's name, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't rerun steps that already finished; they may repeat changes.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The recorded-workflow control_guard blocked a successful finish because mandatory steps are incomplete, or observe found a successful step result missing a required result_present field.

What this means

  • Required steps remain incomplete at finish_task, or a successful operation receipt lacks a required postcondition result pointer. Workflow diagnostics do not execute steps or grant approval. Preserve the pinned definition, original receipts, completed effects and any uncertainty; all execution uses the existing authorization boundary.

Why this can happen

  • Required steps remain incomplete at finish_task, or a successful operation receipt lacks a required postcondition result pointer.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare required step states and declared postcondition pointers with the actual receipt; do not equate this failure with no effect.

How to fix it

  • Check recipe_steps for non-optional steps that are not completed, and compare each step's postconditions with its result data (runtime.control_guard, runtime.observe). Resolve the missing result with a fresh read or complete the remaining required step; do not repeat completed writes.
  • Inspect the existing results and resolve the missing postcondition or required step without repeating completed mutations.

Retry and execution caution

  • Review the workflow and its current run evidence before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • Every mandatory step completes and required result fields are verified in owned receipts.

What not to do

  • Never repeat a write whose effect remains unknown.

Technical notes

  • Workflow diagnostics do not execute steps or grant approval. Preserve the pinned definition, original receipts, completed effects and any uncertainty; all execution uses the existing authorization boundary.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
